info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Order Status Update API
info.description: The Order Status Update API enables real-time modifications to the processing status of banking orders. This endpoint is designed for updating specific attributes of existing orders, allowing businesses to manage and optimize their order flows effectively. Users of this API include banking professionals and system integrators who require dynamic order management capabilities. It supports operations that ensure timely updates to order states, improving overall service delivery and client satisfaction.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific processing order identified by the resource ID RES-100045. It enables you to modify relevant information pertaining to the order and ensure it reflects the latest data.

requestBody.description: This request body requires a JSON object that contains the details necessary to process the order identified by RES-100045. Ensure to include all pertinent fields as defined in the schema.
